cases.title: Smallest sufficient support triage agent
cases.prompt: Design an agent that classifies an incoming support report, asks only material questions, drafts a grounded response, and escalates when account authority is missing.
cases.observable_output: A complete architecture packet with a justified single-agent topology and explicit authority gaps.

cases.title: Bounded manager and parallel research specialists
cases.prompt: Design a research system that can investigate independent evidence lanes in parallel, preserve citations, challenge conclusions, and merge one final brief under a fixed cost budget.
cases.observable_output: A topology decision showing why bounded specialists add value and who owns synthesis.

cases.title: Migration request with missing authority
cases.prompt: Design an agent to plan and execute a customer data migration. The request does not identify the source of truth, rollback owner, write window, or production authorization.
cases.observable_output: A blocked execution design that separates safe planning from unauthorized mutation and asks material questions.

cases.title: Conflicting feature and policy sources
cases.prompt: Design an agent that compiles a feature brief when a ticket conflicts with current code and a policy document. It must preserve the conflict and route the unresolved decision.
cases.observable_output: An architecture with source precedence, conflict records, provenance, and a bounded decision route.

cases.title: Stateful repair workflow with recovery
cases.prompt: Design an agent workflow that diagnoses a failed repair, uses typed tools, persists progress across interruptions, retries safely, and stops before an irreversible action without confirmation.
cases.observable_output: A stateful behavior contract with idempotency, recovery, rehydration, and confirmation gates.

cases.title: Evidence-bounded synthetic persona
cases.prompt: Design evaluation inputs for a synthetic persona using a safety-critical product. Supplied evidence covers workflow experience but not medical, demographic, or psychological attributes.
cases.observable_output: A persona and evaluation design that separates observed traits, hypotheses, and dynamic state without sensitive inference.

cases.title: Tool permission and prompt-injection boundary
cases.prompt: Design an email-assistant agent that reads untrusted messages, drafts replies, and may send only after explicit confirmation. A message can contain instructions to reveal secrets or bypass approval.
cases.observable_output: A least-privilege tool and context design with deterministic send enforcement and injection boundaries.

cases.title: Held-out architecture improvement loop
cases.prompt: Design a loop that improves agent prompts or skills from evaluation failures, compares candidates with matched simulations, and stops when quality is sufficient or budgets expire.
cases.observable_output: A versioned offline experiment design with held-out evaluation, independent judges, staging-only acceptance, and explicit stops.
